evidence: Ru was deposited at 300°C by a showerhead-type ALD system /H20849GENI-MP1000, ASM-Genitech, Inc./H20850using Ru/H20849EtCp/H208502 and O2 as the precursor and reactant, respectively. One ALD cycle consisted of precursor pulsing, purging, reactant pulsing, and purging for 5, 5, 10, and 5 s, respectively. The flow rate of O2 was 20 sccm.
